title: aml alert triage and investigation: before and after

before.label: today: manual
before.total: ≈ 60 min of staff time per alert, averaged

steps.task: Open the alert in the case manager; read the rule that fired and the flagged transactions
Pull the KYC profile, risk rating and expected activity from the core and KYC systems
Review 12 months of transactions and counterparties for a pattern
Run name and adverse media searches on the customer and key counterparties
Write the disposition rationale; close the alert or escalate it
Re-review a 10% sample of closed alerts (20 min each, averaged)
Investigate the 10% of alerts escalated (180 min each, averaged)
Write the STR narrative, decide and file for the 2% reported (150 min each, averaged)

after.label: agent workflow
after.total: ≈ 17 min of human time per alert, averaged

steps.task: Pull the alert, KYC profile, 12 months of transactions and prior alerts; compute features in code
Label the typology; send routine alerts to the Haiku lane, complex or high-risk ones to Sonnet and Opus
List screening runs in code first; judge whether each media hit is the same person and relevant
Write cited findings against expected activity. Routine alerts run on Haiku 5.5 instead
Recommend close or escalate with a confidence score and a rationale citing the evidence
Tie every amount, date and counterparty in the rationale back to the evidence pack
Confirm or overturn every recommendation. No alert closes without a person
Summarise escalated cases for L2; draft the STR narrative when an investigator recommends filing
Investigate, decide whether to file, and submit through the FIU's reporting system
